g.text: Title: Sprocket 2350 | USB-C, LiPo, Wi-Fi/BLE, PSRAM

g.desc: Title: Sprocket 2350 | USB-C, LiPo, Wi-Fi/BLE, PSRAM

g.text: Battery: pin 1 GND, pin 2 BAT. Verify cable polarity.

g.desc: Battery: pin 1 GND, pin 2 BAT. Verify cable polarity.

g.text: External header supplies are references, never power inputs.

g.desc: External header supplies are references, never power inputs.

g.text: UART0 GPIO12/13 to radio RX/TX. GPIO14 controls EN.

g.desc: UART0 GPIO12/13 to radio RX/TX. GPIO14 controls EN.

g.text: Factory radio firmware is not assumed to implement AT commands.

g.desc: Factory radio firmware is not assumed to implement AT commands.

g.text: Antenna overhangs the north board edge. Keep enclosure metal away.

g.desc: Antenna overhangs the north board edge. Keep enclosure metal away.

g.text: Firmware: GPIO0 = QMI CS1n. PSRAM must be initialised explicitly.

g.desc: Firmware: GPIO0 = QMI CS1n. PSRAM must be initialised explicitly.

g.text: RP2350A production stepping A4 preferred. All GPIOs are 3.3 V only.

g.desc: RP2350A production stepping A4 preferred. All GPIOs are 3.3 V only.

g.text: USB default 100 mA, charging disabled, radio in reset.

g.desc: USB default 100 mA, charging disabled, radio in reset.

g.text: Firmware selects 500 mA and enables charging only after enumeration.

g.desc: Firmware selects 500 mA and enables charging only after enumeration.

g.text: Protected 1S LiPo only. TS uses fixed 10 kOhm: no pack temperature sensing.

g.desc: Protected 1S LiPo only. TS uses fixed 10 kOhm: no pack temperature sensing.
